context: A doctor explains an occupational wellness study to a uni student
purpose: Teach: 風土/風潮/全集/もたらさ/変形/楽譜/かかわっ/遂に

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 今日は当院が長年かかわってきた職場ウェルネスの研究についてお話ししましょう。
lines.en: Today let me tell you about the workplace wellness study our hospital has long been involved with.
lines.style: Warm professional opening, measured pace, inviting polite tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ぜひお願いします。卒論で社会の風潮と健康の関係を調べているんです。
lines.en: Please, by all means. For my thesis I'm researching the link between social trends and health.
lines.style: Eager student register, polite and slightly formal.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: いい着眼点だね。会社ごとの風土が社員の睡眠や食事に大きな影響を及ぼすことが分かってきたんだ。
lines.en: Good angle. We've found each company's culture exerts major effects on employees' sleep and diet.
lines.style: Lecturer mode, clear and grounded, slight emphasis throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。ストレスで姿勢が崩れて、腰を痛める人も多いと聞きました。
lines.en: I see. I've heard many end up with collapsed posture and back pain from stress.
lines.style: Curious follow-up, thoughtful and conversational pace.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 実は背骨が変形してしまうケースもあってね、長年の悪い習慣がもたらさざるを得ない結果なんだ。
lines.en: In fact some patients' spines actually deform — an inevitable result brought about by years of bad habits.
lines.style: Serious clinical tone, slight gravity, careful explanation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ある被験者には生活リズムを楽譜のように細かく記録してもらってね、五年かけて遂にパターンを特定したんだ。
lines.en: One subject logged their life rhythm in fine detail like sheet music, and after five years we finally identified the pattern.
lines.style: Storytelling cadence, proud researcher tone, animated delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 五年もですか。先生の論文全集、図書館で探して読んでみます。
lines.en: Five whole years? I'll search the library for your collected papers and read through them.
lines.style: Impressed reaction, respectful and motivated finish.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ありがとう。読み終えたら、ぜひ君の考察も聞かせてほしいな。
lines.en: Thank you. Once you've finished, I'd really love to hear your own analysis as well.
lines.style: Mentor closing, warm encouragement, gentle smile.
